newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Archer Daniels up to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Archer Daniels up to buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said she raised her rating on Archer Daniels Midland Co to a buy from a hold, and increased her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $1.50 a share from $1.40. In fiscal 1996, it earned $1.33.
-- Wittenburg also initiated a fiscal 1998 estimate of $1.80 a share.

-- In a report, Wittenburg said she raised her rating on ADM based on her assumption that the grain and oilseed processing giant would successfully negotiate a plea bargain soon for criminal charges regarding alleged price fixing.

-- No charges have been filed against ADM. Other defendants in federal probe of alleged price fixing have entered pleas of guilty or no contest, including Ajinomoto Co Inc, Kyowa Hakko Kogyo Co and Sewon Co Ltd.
-- Wittenburg said she also expects Chairman Dwayne Andreas and President James Randall will turn leadership of the company over to others, due primarily to their age.
-- Wittenburg said she had no specific knowledge of plans that Andreas or Randall will step down or that the company will negotiate a plea agreement.
-- The company was not immediately available for comment.
-- "We believe the stock will react favorably if the company is able to put this matter to rest," Wittenburg said.
-- She added earnings estimates were raised based on margin improvement due to lower corn prices.
